description: List all rim diameters (in inches) compatible with a given tyre section width and aspect ratio. Use this to discover valid rim_diameter values for search-by-tire.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio as a percentage integer 1-100 (e.g. 45 for a 45-series tyre). Use list-tire-aspect-ratios to enumerate valid values.

region.description: Market region code (e.g. "eudm", "usdm"). Get codes from list-regions.

section_width.description: Tyre section width in mm (e.g. 245). Must be positive. Use list-tire-section-widths to enumerate valid values.

name: list-tire-rim-diameters
